reason: This is a cross-cutting runtime-behavior change, not a local memory cleanup. It touches executor/session/sessionctx paths plus sysvars, stmtctx, process info, slow log, infoschema tables, and integrates with global memory limit / SQL killer / statement summary. A global arbitrator can change query kill behavior, session-visible state, and server correctness under memory pressure, which is central enough to warrant a blocker/high-focused review.
